findings.description: Before stirring the bowl holds about 9 balls, 3 red, 3 yellow, 3 green (00:02.25-00:04.75). Nothing is added or taken out, yet during and after stirring the bowl shows about 5 red balls (00:07.75, 00:09.50) while the yellows drop to 0-1 (none at 00:09.25, one at 00:09.75). Balls seem to change from yellow to red, or reds appear from nowhere, which cannot happen even with hidden handling.

At 00:05.75 the bowl suddenly holds only about 5-6 visible balls (2 green, 2 yellow, 1-2 red under the fingers) instead of the 9 seen at 00:04.75. Most of the bowl is visibly empty glass, so the one stirring hand cannot be hiding 3+ balls, and no ball is seen leaving the bowl. A moment later (00:07.75-00:09.75) the bowl is full again with 8+ balls.

At 00:00 the bowl holds 8 balls (2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green). At 00:00.75-00:01.00 the child holds a red ball above the bowl while both original reds and all 6 other balls are still visible in the bowl, making 9. The hands were blurred in the air at 00:00, so they may have brought the ball in, but no ball is visible in them.
